thread:
mia: Heads-up — Deploybot auto-pinned quant-kernel v3.2.1 into night-quiet pool ~30m ago but the release-notes job errored. Late-shift on call? :eyes:

deploybot: Deploybot: auto-pin applied -> pool=night-quiet, artifact=quant-kernel@v3.2.1, TTL=2h
CI: job/relnotes FAILED: missing changelog entry (exit code 1)

owen: saw the alert. Any functional regressions in telemetry?

aj: quick check: canary slice (5%) p50/p95 within baseline for last 20m, error-rate 0.02%. no obvious regressions. I don't want to rollback just for relnotes.

katie: I can write the blurb. What exact wording do we want in CHANGELOG?

mia: something short — "quant-kernel v3.2.1: fix matmul overflow for seq>2048; improve long-context latency and KV-cache stability." That should satisfy relnotes job.

aj: two operational questions: 1) do we extend pin TTL so docs team can merge? 2) rollback criteria if we see perf flare?

sre-oncall: rollback triggers proposed: p50 increase >50ms over baseline OR sustained error-rate >0.2% for 5m. Also thermal OOM alerts auto-rollback.

owen: agree with SRE thresholds. For question 1, can we extend?

mia: yes. katie will open the PR and we can extend TTL to avoid an automatic unpin mid-fix.

katie: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/relnotes/pull/7890 — adds entry and links to CI artifacts. Diff below:

```
- quant-kernel: (pending)
+ quant-kernel v3.2.1 — Fixes
+ - Fix matmul overflow for sequences >2048
+ - Lowers p50 latency for long-context workloads
+ - KV-cache stability improvements
```

aj: /deploybot pin extend --pool night-quiet --ttl 2h  <-- running this now

deploybot: Command accepted. Existing TTL 2h -> extended by 2h. New TTL=4h.

mia: thanks. katie, once PR merges, can you trigger relnotes job re-run?

katie: merged and re-run queued. relnotes job re-run status: RUNNING

deploybot: relnotes job completed: SUCCESS. Entry detected in CHANGELOG.

aj: ok. since telemetry looks stable and relnotes passed, propose unpin and keep 5% canary for 30m before ramp.

owen: +1. I'll watch for the SRE triggers. If nothing bad in 30m, schedule staggered ramp to 25% then regional ramp overnight.

sre-oncall: monitoring hooks attached. alerting window set to 5m slices. I'll escalate if any threshold crosses. :thumbsup:

mia: /deploybot unpin --pool night-quiet --reason "relnotes fixed, proceed with canary"

deploybot: Unpin accepted. Pool night-quiet no longer pinned. Canary remains at 5% for 30m as requested.

ak: (after 18m) — telemetry note: p95 latency +12ms (within tolerance), errors unchanged.

owen: good. scheduling ramp plan in release tracker for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. I'll update release-notes to include rollforward steps.

mia: summary: auto-pin prevented accidental mass rollout, relnotes blocked automated promotion, team extended TTL, fixed changelog, unpinned, canary holds 30m. No rollback needed. Great ops. :party_popper:
